notes: «بإسناده» points to an earlier chain that the packet does not carry; it is written as a back reference, not completed.
Hafs relates his own encounter («دخلتُ على أبي عبد الله»), and the Imam speaks inside it: whether the Imam is a link or only in the scene is left to the ruling (rule 11, first-person narrative).
«فرعان» is a laqab and stays in the name as written.
